title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 6: the Philistines send back the ark with a trespass offering, and it comes to Beth Shemesh.

questions.text: How long was Yahweh's ark in the country of the Philistines?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 6:1 says Yahweh's ark was in the country of the Philistines seven months.

questions.text: Whom did the Philistines call to ask what to do with the ark?
questions.explanation: The Philistines called for the priests and the diviners.

questions.text: What did they say must not happen when the ark was sent away?
questions.explanation: They said, "Don't send it empty; but by all means return a trespass offering to him."

answers.text: It must not be sent empty
It must not be sent by night
It must not be touched by a woman
It must not pass through Gath

questions.text: What was the trespass offering to be?
questions.explanation: They said: five golden tumors and five golden mice, for the number of the lords of the Philistines.

answers.text: Five silver bowls and five silver rings
Seven golden calves and seven lamps
Five golden tumors and five golden mice
Ten bars of silver and ten of gold

questions.text: What were the Philistines to prepare to carry the ark?
questions.explanation: They were to prepare a new cart and two milk cows on which no yoke had come.

answers.text: A new cart and two milk cows never yoked
Priests to carry it on poles

questions.text: Toward which town did the cows take the straight way?
questions.explanation: The cows took the straight way by the way to Beth Shemesh, lowing as they went.

questions.text: What were the people of Beth Shemesh doing when they saw the ark?
questions.explanation: They were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley, and they rejoiced to see the ark.

answers.text: Reaping their wheat harvest in the valley
Building a new altar to Yahweh on the hill
Mourning for their dead at the city gate

questions.text: In whose field did the cart stop, where there was a great stone?
questions.explanation: The cart came into the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh and stood there, where there was a great stone.

questions.text: Why did Yahweh strike the men of Beth Shemesh?
questions.explanation: He struck the men of Beth Shemesh because they had looked into Yahweh's ark.

answers.text: They had refused to offer sacrifices
They had looked into Yahweh's ark
They had sent the ark away

questions.text: To the inhabitants of which place did the men of Beth Shemesh send messengers about the ark?
questions.explanation: They sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath Jearim, asking them to come and bring the ark up.
